g.text: What it shows: post-money valuation divided by the annualised revenue recorded nearest to it, so the price of each round

g.text: is expressed against the revenue it was struck on. 26 rounds across 6 companies where both sides exist within a year.

g.text: Note: A revenue multiple is only as good as the gap between the two dates - median 29 days here - and at these growth rates revenue moves

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: materially inside that gap. Valuations are set by a single negotiated round, not a market price. Rounds with no revenue observation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: within a year are dropped rather than matched to a distant one.
